lp.title: TerraOrb: your season's direction, read from space
lp.desc: Rain, tank water, crop advice, climate lessons and trip planning for Sri Lanka, built on NASA satellite data.
lp.hero.title: Your season's direction, read from space.
lp.hero.sub: TerraOrb turns satellite rain, tank water and weather forecasts into plain advice for farmers, students, officers, researchers and travellers across Sri Lanka.
lp.stat.ends: tools, one for each kind of user
lp.stat.note: Counted live from the project's data files.
lp.story.title: From satellite to your decision, in three steps.
lp.step1.title: Satellites watch
lp.step1.text: NASA satellites measure rain, heat, green land and the water in tanks, every day, from space.
lp.step2.title: We read the signs
lp.step2.text: Open rules compare today with 45 years of history and the latest forecast, and show where the numbers come from.
lp.step3.title: You decide
lp.step3.text: Plain words, colours and next steps: sow now or wait, share the water, plan the trip, teach the class.
lp.services.title: One platform, five ways in.
lp.services.sub: Every part uses the same NASA data and weather forecasts. Pick the one that fits you.
lp.farmer.name: For farmers
lp.farmer.lead: Is my tank full? What should I sow? Will it rain today?
lp.farmer.f1: Tank water now versus usual, as a green, amber or red signal
lp.farmer.f2: What to sow now and a 12-week sowing calendar
lp.farmer.f3: Weekly advice, live rain and heavy-rain warnings
lp.farmer.f4: A farm planner with three crop plans for your own land
lp.learn.name: For children and students
lp.learn.lead: Water, weather and climate, learned by playing.
lp.learn.f1: 16 picture lessons: raindrops, El Niño, glaciers, global warming
lp.learn.f2: Games for little farmers, with rewards, badges and a certificate
lp.learn.f3: Challenges that use real tank data
lp.officer.name: For officers and instructors
lp.officer.lead: Every tank at a glance, ready for the field visit.
lp.officer.f1: A sign-in dashboard of all tanks with signals and filters
lp.officer.f2: Live rain for the next 6 hours and greenness from NASA MODIS
lp.officer.f3: CSV download and a clean printable report
lp.research.name: For judges and researchers
lp.research.lead: Check the method, and where it does not work well.
lp.research.f1: Backtests shown honestly, good results and bad
lp.research.f2: Every data source, licence and known problem listed
lp.research.f3: Open, separable modules you can rerun
lp.plan.name: For travellers and event planners
lp.plan.lead: Will it rain where you are going, and which day is best?
lp.plan.f1: Hour-by-hour rain, wind, sun and heat for any place
lp.plan.f2: Best dates, place comparison and smart suggestions
lp.plan.f3: A travel copilot, a rain-aware itinerary and a packing list
lp.value.title: Plain answers you can trust, from data you can check.
lp.v1.title: Plain words first
lp.v1.text: Made for people with little technical knowledge: colours and short advice first, numbers only when you ask.
lp.v2.title: Never invented
lp.v2.text: If a number is missing, we say so. Demo data is marked. Forecasts are never passed off as history.
lp.v3.title: Every value has a source
lp.v3.text: NASA data and non-NASA data are labelled differently, so you always know what you are looking at.
lp.v4.title: Sinhala and English
lp.v4.text: Switch language any time. The Sinhala is a draft that native speakers are still reviewing.
lp.v5.title: Works on a phone, even offline
lp.v5.text: Install it like an app. Pages you have opened stay available without internet.
lp.v6.title: Open and checkable
lp.v6.text: Backtests, thresholds and known problems are published, so experts can review and improve them.
lp.benefits.title: What changes for you.
lp.b1.text: Decide when to sow, which crop fits the water, and when to share it, before the season is lost.
lp.b2.text: One shared picture of the tanks, so decisions about water are made together and early.
lp.b3.text: See which tanks need a visit first, and download or print the list.
lp.b4.text: Understand water, weather and climate through stories, games and real data.
lp.b5.text: Pick the right day and place, pack what you need, and keep a plan that adapts to the rain.
lp.b6.text: A transparent example of turning NASA Earth data into local decisions, with its limits shown.
lp.data.title: Ten NASA datasets, labelled honestly.
lp.data.n1: POWER: rain, temperature, humidity, wind and sunshine since 1981
lp.data.n2: MODIS: greenness, water the land loses, ground heat and land cover
lp.data.n3: GIBS: satellite maps of floods, cloud, night lights and haze
lp.data.honest: Honest about limits: each farm and tank card shows its source, SMAP and MODIS values are area-level, the tank-water check covers only some tanks, the Sinhala text is a draft, and thresholds await expert review.
lp.cta.title: Ready to read the season?
lp.cta.sub: Open the part that fits you. It is free, and most of it needs no sign-in.
lp.footer: TerraOrb was built for the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026, "Field Shift: Adapting Farms with NASA Data". It supports your own knowledge and your Agricultural Instructor; it does not replace them.
lp.data.n5: GPM IMERG: rain seen from space
lp.data.n6: SMAP: soil moisture measured by satellite
lp.data.n7: GLDAS: soil moisture model, top and deeper soil
